# helm-lite

A trimmed package manager for Kubernetes.

## Install

```sh
ocx pull cloud/helm-lite@latest
ocx run cloud/helm-lite -- --help
```

## Highlights

- Ships as a single static binary.
- Pinned by digest, never by moving tag.
- Reads configuration from the environment.

| Platform | Supported |
| --- | --- |
| linux/amd64 | yes |
| darwin/arm64 | yes |

See the [project page](https://example.com/cloud/helm-lite) for details.
